newsitem.title: PUERTO RICO: Eighteen dead, 25 injured in Puerto Rico blast.
newsitem.headline: Eighteen dead, 25 injured in Puerto Rico blast.

text.p: Eighteen people were killed and 25 injured early on Thursday when a suspected gas leak caused a powerful explosion at a shoe store, officials said.
Police said they feared more people were still trapped in the destroyed building, which was located in the Rio Piedras neighbourhood of San Juan.
Police chief Jose Rosa Carraqueno said in an interview with Telemundo television at the scene: "We know that a lot of people are trapped here."
Police spokesman Ramon Rodriguez said the casualty toll could rise.
Health officials said many injuries were severe.
"We've got four or five patients on respirators, several others with severe burns and many more patients on the way," Puerto Rico Health Secretary Carmen Feliciano said at a nearby hospital.
An aide to Governor Pedro Rosello said a gas leak was suspected as the cause of the blast.

"We do know there was a San Juan Gas truck there," said Rosello's press aide, Juan Carlos Molina. "We suspect that it's related to a gas leak but that is still not confirmed. It was a rather large explosion."
Rodriguez said the store was in commercial shopping area near a crowded plaza that served as an informal terminal for commuter vans.
Stores up to 220 yards (200 metres) away had their glass shattered by the explosion.
